name: agentic-workshop
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install --yes --no-install-recommends libgit2-dev libxslt1-dev python3-venv && sudo find /workspaces/Intro-to-Agentic-Coding -path /workspaces/Intro-to-Agentic-Coding/.git -prune -o -exec chmod a+rwX {} + && python3 -m venv "$HOME/.venv" && "$HOME/.venv/bin/pip" install pandas scikit-learn pytest && sudo Rscript -e 'install.packages(c("rmarkdown", "knitr", "here", "tidyverse", "DBI", "RMySQL", "readr"), repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")' && sudo Rscript -e 'install.packages(c("sandpaper", "varnish", "pegboard"), repos = c("https://carpentries.r-universe.dev", "https://cloud.r-project.org"))'
